articles.summary: The American Lawyer features a quote by Chief Development Officer Travis Lenkner in relation to management services organizations, or MSOs, in the legal services market. Lenkner says: "'Burford Capital is the world’s largest purpose-built investor in the legal industry. From our conversations with leading global firms, it’s clear that larger, more sophisticated firms are actively exploring how to use MSOs to secure long-term competitiveness.'" Learn more.
articles.title: The American Lawyer highlights Travis Lenkner on the growing role of MSOs in legal services

articles.summary: The Korea Economic Daily writes about Burford's leadership in the legal finance industry and quotes Jonathan Molot, citing his comments in this year's shareholder letter: "'Our asset modeling is based on a vast amount of proprietary data. This allows us to precisely measure the risk and potential returns of the litigation we invest in.' He added, 'We're not simply a lender; we're a technology-driven financial firm that quantitatively analyzes and prices legal risk.'" Learn more.
articles.title: The Korea Economic Daily discusses Burford's industry leadership

articles.summary: Law360 reports on how law firms are innovating their funding of business operations.
